name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Built on Saintdoggie's upstream 0.0.207, so it brings everything added there since 0.0.199: security and transport hardening, adaptive playback from measured connection speed, better phone, tablet and Android app playback, Playback Info that shows the real route, sparse settings saves that no longer erase friends or sharing settings, and the optional Plex add-in (Plex users: install Jellyfin.Plugin.Federation.Plex-0.0.208.zip from this release). On top of that, as proposed upstream in PR #16: friends see none of your users unless you share them, you choose which of your friends each friend sees, sharing can end on a date and the preview shows what a friend gets, popular titles and viewer names are shared only by choice, a friend's conversion log holds only its own conversion, and speed tests count toward a friend's data limit. Fixed: a title could stay refused (403) for up to a day after a friend's server restarted; tokens are now saved at shutdown and session tokens survive restarts. Friends' viewers whose names can't be verified show as "Someone (friend)" instead of disappearing from the dashboard. Coming from 0.0.196: this month's data totals carry over and the old "Popular on" collections are removed. Update both servers.
